# Hope's Retreat (JE-1758 'Ascanius')
[italic]Date - 2181. Tidally-locked planet JE-1758 Ascanius, locally referred to as Hope's Retreat by colonists. Nominally under an ICSC charter but host to various facilities of various allegiances, including the United Americas, Union of Progressive Peoples and Three-World Empire.[/italic]
[italic]Each day, he steps in to the yard, to earn his wages working hard. I pray to the stars, and Heaven above, to return my father to those he loves. If there comes a time when he and death meet, lest the next miner that takes his seat.[/italic]
## The Colony Among the Stars of the Middle Heavens, flung out toward the edge of all man's grasp, lies a colony languishing in the daylight.
[bold]Hope's Retreat[/bold] was born of a diverted colonial transport, turned aside after its passengers received the terrible news that their intended destination was gone. The colony has been cobbled together from prefabs and duct tape, a stone's throw from the "generous corporate benefactors" who allocated its land on the "habitable" strip of JE-1758, a world slowly becoming tidally locked.
The colony lives on borrowed time. Within two generations, the hard-fought claim Hope's Retreat stands on will be nothing but crystallizing desert sand, as the planet's star reduces what remains of it to a sea of rolling dunes where no one can set foot. That is, if something doesn't get to the colony first.
## The Planet Today - Hope's Retreat sits on the highly contested fringes where the space of the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] (TWE), the [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"] (UPP) and the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] (UA) meet. - It is home to a publicly facing [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] (W-Y) research colony, the [bold]Octanis Research Complex[/bold], sheltered beneath a hollowed-out mesa. - Just outside the complex's finely polished gates lies the poverty-stricken colony itself. The two are separated by podlocks and cave systems. - The caves hide a litany of [textlink="Colonial Liberation Front" link="CMUGuideLoreCLF"] (CLF) hideouts. - A sectioned-off security forces base stands elsewhere on the planet.
